mapper.update: UPDATE integration.if_request SET simulation_id=CAST(#{simulationId} AS uuid) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.if_request(id,request_id,interface_id,trace_id,status,source_system,interface_version,original_payload,processing_stage) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),#{request.requestId},#{request.interfaceId},#{traceId},'VALIDATING',#{definition.sourceSystem},#{definition.version},CAST(#{original} AS jsonb),'SOURCE_VALIDATION')
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.if_request SET mapped_payload=CAST(#{mapped} AS jsonb),status=#{status},processing_stage=#{stage}, validation_errors=CAST(#{errors} AS jsonb),error_code=CASE WHEN #{status}='MAPPING_FAILED' THEN 'MAPPING_ERROR' WHEN #{status}='VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'VALIDATION_ERROR' ELSE NULL END, duration_ms=#{duration},updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status='VALIDATING'
UPDATE integration.if_request SET status='SENDING',attempt_id=CAST(#{attemptId} AS uuid),processing_stage='REQUEST_DISPATCHED',updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status='READY'

UPDATE integration.if_request SET status=#{status},http_status=#{httpStatus},error_code=#{errorCode},response_payload=CAST(#{response} AS jsonb), processing_stage='RESPONSE_PROCESSED',duration_ms=#{duration},updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status='SENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'requestId',request_id,'interfaceId',interface_id,'traceId',trace_id,'attemptId',attempt_id, 'status',status,'interfaceVersion',interface_version,'processingStage',processing_stage,'errorCode',error_code, 'httpStatus',http_status,'durationMs',duration_ms,'createdAt',created_at)::text FROM integration.if_request ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'requestId',request_id,'interfaceId',interface_id,'traceId',trace_id,'attemptId',attempt_id, 'status',status,'interfaceVersion',interface_version,'processingStage',processing_stage,'errorCode',error_code, 'httpStatus',http_status,'durationMs',duration_ms,'createdAt',created_at)::text FROM integration.if_request
AND (created_at,id) < (#{after},CAST(#{afterId} AS uuid)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'requestId',r.request_id,'interfaceId',r.interface_id,'traceId',r.trace_id,'attemptId',r.attempt_id, 'status',r.status,'simulationId',r.simulation_id,'interfaceVersion',r.interface_version,'processingStage',r.processing_stage,'errorCode',r.error_code, 'httpStatus',r.http_status,'durationMs',r.duration_ms,'createdAt',r.created_at,'originalPayload',r.original_payload, 'mappedPayload',r.mapped_payload,'response',r.response_payload,'errors',r.validation_errors,'interfaceSnapshot',v.snapshot)::text FROM integration.if_request r LEFT JOIN integration.if_interface_version v ON v.interface_id=r.interface_id AND v.version=r.interface_version WHERE r.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
